newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Sept 16.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Monday's Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - Sony's Columbia TriStar nabbed the top two spots at the weekend box office, with Maximum Risk and Fly Away Home, just as Chairman Mark Canton was separated from the company.
HOLLYWOOD - Mark Canton officially left Columbia TriStar on Friday. Vice Chairwoman Lucy Fisher and President Fred Bernstein will take over.
HOLLYWOOD - Arnold Rifkin ended talks with Sony for Canton's job by signing a long-term contract that extends his tenure at the William Morris Agency.
HOLLYWOOD - Al Pacino is in "advanced" talks to play CIA turncoat Aldrich Ames.
HOLLYWOOD - Roger Spottiswoode is in "final negotiations" to direct the next James Bond film for MGM-UA.
